problems.title: Sound familiar?
problems.intro: What owners of salons, clinics, shops and agencies tell us most often — and what Riseup does about it.

items.title: Messages at night stay unanswered
items.text: A client writes at 23:00, nobody answers, and in the morning they've booked somewhere else.
items.system: An AI administrator answers Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram 24/7.

items.title: The same questions all day
items.text: “How much is it?”, “Any free time?”, “Where are you?” — a hundred times a day.
items.system: The AI knows your prices, hours and address and answers for you.

items.title: Clients forget their visit
items.text: The master waits, the client doesn't come, the hour is lost.
items.outcome: Fewer empty hours in the day.

items.title: Orders get lost in Direct
items.text: Orders are mixed with other messages, stock is counted in a notebook.
items.system: The AI takes the order and puts it on one order board.
items.outcome: Every order is delivered on time.

items.title: Buyers and listings get mixed up
items.text: Requests come from list.am, Instagram and calls, and nobody remembers who wanted what.
items.system: One list of buyers and listings, with reminders to call back.

items.title: No time for Instagram and Google
items.text: Posts are rare, reviews are few, and people can't find you on the map.
items.system: A monthly content plan, a cared-for Google profile and review requests.
items.outcome: New clients find you more often.

about.title: Riseup helps small businesses in Armenia work faster with AI.
about.intro: We are a small team in Yerevan. We build simple AI tools that answer clients, take bookings and orders, and help businesses be found — at prices local businesses can afford.
about.manifesto: Good technology is almost invisible. The owner simply notices that clients get answers and the day is less chaotic.

approach.title: We learn your business
approach.text: We learn how the company sells, delivers and makes decisions before we propose anything.

approach.title: We see the whole picture
approach.text: We look at the whole chain — people, processes, data and tools — not a single screen.

approach.title: Simple to use
approach.text: Interfaces and workflows are designed to be obvious for the people who use them every day.

approach.title: Reliable technology
approach.text: Clean architecture, solid integrations and security are part of the design, not afterthoughts.

approach.title: AI where it helps
approach.text: We use AI where it measurably helps, with guardrails, review and a human in the loop.

approach.title: We stay with you
